value.rationale: The exact sharp extinction times and full arrival-time histograms for two canonical small triangle-free four-chromatic networks are natural finite dynamical invariants under a motivated contact-threshold change. The one-contact survivors and K4,4 two-contact oscillator demonstrate a substantive threshold-sensitive and graph-sensitive distinction, not mere input-size enumeration. The precise populations serve as reproducible benchmarks for excitable-media network dynamics.
